subject: Does fscores(multipleGroup(data,model,group)) calculate ability based on all groups or each group?

messages.author: a6c3e7604e5af1a7
messages.subject: Does fscores(multipleGroup(data,model,group)) calculate ability based on all groups or each group?
parts:
Does fscores(multipleGroup(data,model,group)) calculate ability based on all groups or each group?
For example,If one testee's ability in fscores(multipleGroup(data,model,group)) is 1,Is that means this testee's ability is 1 within all groups or this testee's ability is 1 within his own group?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Does fscores(multipleGroup(data,model,group)) calculate ability based on all groups or each group?
parts:
The answer depends on precisely what you are asking. A theta = 1 is the same regardless of the group, so that value will be estimated regardless. But, multiple group models will also include prior information via the hyper-parameters, so the value of 1 may be more or less likely in one group or another according to the estimated distribution. 

Phil
